description.en: A self-hosted format-1 index containing the 小说模式 (Novel Mode) plugin.
description.zh: 自托管的 format-1 索引，收录「小说模式」插件。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds a 小说模式 (Novel Mode) button and a /novel command: entering the mode materializes a bundled .dsh working copy of novel-writing skills, subagent roles, PowerShell and Python scripts, templates, config and rules into the current project, then routes the model through the constitution, outline, design, writing, batch and validation stages.
description.zh: 把长篇小说写作流程接入 DeepSeek Harness：新增「小说模式」按钮与 /novel 命令，进入模式时把随包附带的技能、子代理角色、PowerShell 与 Python 脚本、模板、配置与规则物化到当前项目的 .dsh/ 目录，并按宪法、大纲、设计、写作、批量、校验各阶段引导模型。

_notes: This is a COMPLETE format-1 index whose plugins[] holds exactly ONE plugin object — it is directly hostable after you fill the two placeholders below. DSH ignores unknown top-level members, so you may delete this _notes field before hosting.

WHERE TO HOST: serve this file (plus any icons/ dir) from any static host — GitHub Pages (e.g. https://github-yousen.github.io/novel/index.json from the repo's docs/ or a gh-pages branch), GitLab Pages, or an object store. Requirements: https, 2xx status, NO redirects, <=128 MiB, URL contains NO '# fragment' and NO user/password. A relative icon resolves against the index URL.

PLACEHOLDER 1 — source.commit MUST be a 40-character hex SHA of the pushed commit (git rev-parse HEAD after STEP 0 in SUBMISSION_STEPS.md). The placeholder string is NOT 40-hex, so DSH would reject the whole index until it is replaced. DSH installs a git version as git+<url>.git#<commit> with &path:<directory>.
PLACEHOLDER 2 — publishTimestamp is Unix seconds; 1794182400 is 2026-11-09T00:00:00Z. Replace with the real push time, e.g. git log -1 --format=%ct.

HOW USERS FIND IT: this is the READ/Discover side, NOT the official submission channel (that is the awesome-dsh-plugin data/plugins/*.yml PR). On dsh 0.2.1+ the user must enable the experimental 'Custom plugin indexes' bundle, then go to Plugins -> Discover -> Index sources -> Add index source and paste the hosted URL. It is per-profile volatile config (setIndexes), ~10 min cache, 15 s fetch timeout, indexes are unsigned — add only trusted sources. This machine's plugin_market list_indexes is currently empty.
engines.dsh is copied verbatim from the plugin's package.json; the host re-checks it (or the @deepseek-ai/dsh* peer ranges) on install.

icon is intentionally omitted (optional). If added, use an inline base64 data: URL (<=32 KiB, SVG/PNG/JPEG/WebP) or a relative/https URL; note the CATALOG tile (contributing.md) refuses SVG, but the format-1 index icon does allow SVG.
